name: alphafold2
tagline_zh: 粘贴序列，一键预测蛋白结构。单体复合物都行，自带pLDDT和ipTM评分，验证设计序列是否靠谱。
tagline_en: Paste a sequence, get a folded structure. Handles monomers and multimers with pLDDT/ipTM scores—no AlphaFold.
desc_en: Predict protein structure for monomers and multimers with AlphaFold2 via the ColabFold runner (Mirdita et al. 2022, github.com/sokrypton/ColabFold; AlphaFold2 Jumper et al. 2021). Reach for this skill to fold a sequence or complex with the AF2/AF2-Multimer evoformer, to validate designed sequences by self-consistency pLDDT, ipTM, and RMSD, or to run a quick MSA-backed prediction using the public M
why_zh: 直接用ColabFold跑AF2，省去装环境配GPU的麻烦，还能批量验证设计，评分指标齐全。
why_en: Runs AF2 via ColabFold—no setup hassle, supports multimers, and outputs all key metrics for design validation in one go.
